verdict.rationale: ADK provides a Tool Confirmation (HITL) flow that can gate tool execution with explicit confirmation/custom input, plus callbacks/plugins hooks to intercept agent actions, giving some control over agent behavior. However there is no evidence of fine-grained per-tool permission policies or an actual sandboxed execution environment for code/tool runs. Missing for 10: explicit sandboxing of tool/code execution, a permissions/ACL system scoping tool access, and independent verification of these guardrails in practice.
